label: Copy phase only: last output of length-3 sequences, plus repeated digit 2 being fed back
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never on original inputs or <DEL>, and only on re-inputs of tokens already seen (in_first=0). The strongest and cleanest component is the final output step of length-3 sequences (L=3, t=5, input orig(1), output orig(2)): about 91% precision, 42% of activation mass, and every top activation (inputs like 2, j, 0, f). The remaining weaker, scattered activations fall at recall_idx>=2 in longer sequences and depend strongly on which token is being fed back: 2 is about 8.5x enriched, with 0, g, and j about 3.5x. The input-2 clause adds roughly 23% of mass at about 18% precision. Activations outside L=3 are small (mostly under 0.4 of max), and the token-dependent part is not cleanly captured.
